newsitem.title: USA: Patient Infosystems sees Q2 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Patient Infosystems sees Q2 shr loss.

text.p: Patient Infosystems Inc said Tuesday that for the three months ended June 30, it expects to report revenues ranging from $600,000 to $650,000 and a net loss in the range of $800,000 to $900,000, or $0.10 to $0.11 per share.
The company said this compares to revenues of $299,181 and a net loss of $711,701, or $0.12 per share in the year-earlier period.

The company also said that it has begun to offer its customers certain programs whose ultimate revenues are determined by the results of the program. These programs, said the company may delay the recognition of some revenues.

Patient Infosystems designs, develops, implements and operates disease- specific compliance programs that integrate live telephone operators, an advanced voice recognition system, high-speed data processing and demand publishing and information distribution.
